title: EIP-1967 transparent proxy implementation slot
detects: A non-zero value is the address of the logic contract this proxy currently delegates to. The logic can be swapped by whoever holds the admin slot.
knownFalseNegative: Contracts deployed before EIP-1967 was standardised do not use this slot. USDC reads zero here and IS still a proxy. Always evaluate proxy-zeppelinos and proxy-uups before concluding a contract is non-upgradeable.

coversExamples.observed: 2491 bytes of code, evaluated for proxy slots

rationale: The dominant modern proxy standard. Without it, upgradeable tokens read as immutable.
